title: Note the IANA reserved domains
description: Write down the domains IANA reserves for documentation in a TextEdit note.
outcome: A TextEdit document lists the reserved documentation domains and their source.
when_to_use: When you need the reserved example domains at hand.

steps.action: Open TextEdit and create a new document.
steps.description: Start a blank document for the notes.
steps.verify: An empty TextEdit window is open.

steps.action: Open Safari and navigate to the IANA reserved domains page.
steps.description: The page lists the reserved domains.
steps.verify: The IANA-managed Reserved Domains page is shown.

steps.action: Scroll down the page and click the 'Example Domain' link.
steps.description: Open the Example Domain entry to see the reserved names.

steps.action: Switch back to TextEdit and type the reserved domain list.
steps.description: Write the domains into the document.

steps.action: Select the typed text in the TextEdit document.

success_criteria: The document lists example.com, example.net and example.org.
common_errors: TextEdit may open the file browser instead of a new document; press Cmd-N.
